pane.originalHint: — drag over the text to anonymise more
pane.anonymizedHint: — hover a placeholder to reveal it
pane.sealHint: — draw a rectangle: whatever is underneath is removed from the file
pane.sealToggleHint: Draw a black rectangle that permanently removes the content underneath from the anonymised file

page.originalGone: Original unavailable (upload the file again to see it).

applying: Applying the change: re-redacting the document from the original…
busy: Processing under way on this file (OCR reprocessing or a column): the preview updates by itself when it finishes.

warn.residual: WARNING: {{count}} values are still readable in the PDF (residuals: {{values}}).
warn.skipped: {{count}} values were too short to redact and stay in the clear: {{values}}.
warn.sealed_one: One sealed area: the content under the black rectangles has been removed from the file and cannot be decoded (hover the rectangle to remove the seal).
warn.sealed_other: {{count}} sealed areas: the content under the black rectangles has been removed from the file and cannot be decoded (hover a rectangle to remove the seal).
warn.truncated: Partial preview: the sheet is large, so you only see the first rows of each tab here. The downloadable file is anonymised in full.
warn.tableColumns: Tabular sheet: the model analysed a sample of rows and these columns were anonymised in full: {{columns}}.

box.sealedHelp: The content under the rectangle has been removed from the anonymised file (it is not in the map and cannot be decoded).

selection.noTextOcr: No text in the selection, not even with OCR.
selection.caption: Selected text — tweak it if the selection is not precise
selection.ocr: This area has no selectable text (it is an image): the text was read with OCR.
selection.noOcrCache: This file was anonymised without OCR, so I cannot cover text inside images.
selection.noOcrReprocess: Reprocess the file with OCR on (it goes into the queue, like uploads) and then repeat the selection.
selection.notInOcrCache: The OCR of the clipped area read text that does not appear in the reading taken at send time: anonymisation would not find it. Widen the selection (whole words or line) and try again.
selection.noOcrResend: Send again with OCR enabled in the attachments popup.
selection.saveTerm: Anonymise in future too (in my next documents and chats)
selection.tagHint: A running number is appended to the tag, so every value stays distinguishable: [TAG_1], [TAG_2], …

seal.caption: Seal this area
seal.note: Everything under the rectangle (text and images) will be permanently removed from the anonymised file: no entry in the map, not decodable. You can lift the seal from here, but downloaded copies stay sealed.
seal.allPages: Apply at the same position on every page

column.stripTitle: Column {{col}} ({{sheet}}): click to anonymise or reveal the whole column
column.busy: This document already has processing under way.
column.anonBody: The whole {{where}} will be anonymised: {{values}} distinct values{{mapped}}. It applies to the entire file, beyond the rows shown in the preview.
column.anonBodyMapped: , of which {{count}} are already in the map
column.anonHow: Every distinct value not yet in the map gets its own [CUSTOM_n] placeholder (values already mapped reuse theirs): no model analysis, the result is deterministic.
column.anonHowJob: The processing is queued and you follow it from the sidebar, like uploads; meanwhile the document is locked against other changes.
column.anonHowSync: The anonymisation happens straight away and the whole message is re-redacted, like the other changes in the preview.
column.deanonBody: The {{count}} placeholders covering the values of {{where}} will leave the decoding map and those values become readable again wherever they appear in the document, including other columns or sheets (placeholders work by value, not by position).

deanon.bodyOne: The value becomes readable again in every occurrence in the document and the placeholder leaves the decoding map.
deanon.bodyAll: The {{count}} placeholders of category {{label}} become readable again in every occurrence and leave the decoding map.

mapping.intro: Each placeholder always stands for the same value in the document. The map stays on this server and is what makes decoding possible. Revealing a placeholder removes it from the document and from the map everywhere.
